Confidentiality terms

1. Confidentiality

All content accessible through this space — studies, observations, evidence, methodology and associated materials — is strictly confidential and remains the exclusive property of NewVision Insight.

2. Restricted use

This content is provided for your internal use only. Any reproduction, distribution, publication or communication to a third party, in whole or in part, is prohibited without the prior written agreement of NewVision Insight.

3. Methodology

The methods, protocols and know-how of NewVision Insight are protected confidential information. You undertake not to disclose or use them outside the agreed scope.

4. Duration

This undertaking applies from the moment of access and continues without limitation of time.

5. Acceptance

By ticking the box and entering the space, you form a confidentiality undertaking that you acknowledge to be binding. Without acceptance, access is not authorised.
